checks.message: LuxC.hmm is a structurally valid HMMER3 ASCII amino-acid profile HMM with 400 match positions
NAME/ACC/DESC/LENG/NSEQ/CKSUM and GA/TC/NC cutoff lines match the reference model
effective sequence number, MSV/VITERBI/FORWARD calibration statistics, COMPO block and all 400 per-position emission/insert/transition parameters match the reference model
LuxC.domtbl is a well-formed hmmsearch domain table with 12 data rows
all 12 reported domains match the reference in order: target identity, scores, E-values, coordinates and descriptions
every domain-table row reports the query name/accession/length of the profile HMM in LuxC.hmm
